entry.title: Tom Lee: Crypto Could Get as Big as AI

media:group.media:title: Tom Lee: Crypto Could Get as Big as AI
media:group.media:description: Why Crypto Could Outgrow AI Itself⁣ ⁣ Machine-to-machine payments don't need traditional finance rails, they need something faster and permissionless.⁣ ⁣ "The AI world and an agentic world... probably sees a lot less value in traditional financial settlement rails."⁣ ⁣ Microtransactions, taxation, real-world instructions, all running on blockchain instead of centralized systems.⁣ ⁣ "Why even, that's actually much more complicated than running these things on blockchain rails."⁣ ⁣ If AI is already a $10T economy heading toward $100T:⁣ ⁣ "Is crypto gonna be stuck at $1.5T? I'm highly, highly doubtful of that."🎬

entry.title: Tom Lee: BitMine's 9.5% Preferred Is a Cheap 3-Year ETH Call Option

media:group.media:title: Tom Lee: BitMine's 9.5% Preferred Is a Cheap 3-Year ETH Call Option
media:group.media:description: Why BitMine’s 9.5% Preferred Is Secretly a Cheap ETH Call Option⁣ ⁣ A 9.5% preferred sounds expensive. It’s actually the opposite.⁣ ⁣ “If you wanted to buy a three year call on Ethereum… your option premium would be close to a 100%.”⁣ ⁣ BitMine isn’t issuing stock, they’re using BMNR preferred to buy ETH outright — structurally the same as owning that call option.⁣ ⁣ “It’s costing us nine and a half percent a year. It’s a really cheap call option to acquire ETH.” 🎬

entry.title: Tom Lee: AI Doesn't Kill Crypto, It Makes It More Important

media:group.media:title: Tom Lee: AI Doesn't Kill Crypto, It Makes It More Important
media:group.media:description: Why AI Makes Crypto MORE Important, Not Less⁣ ⁣ Everyone thinks crypto is uninvestable while AI sucks up all the oxygen.⁣ ⁣ “Can you imagine going to a meeting and one person wants to talk about AI stocks and the other guy wants to talk about apartment housing?”⁣ ⁣ But the downstream story is where the money gets made or missed.⁣ ⁣ “Many people thought software was dead… it’s actually a downstream story to AI.”⁣ ⁣ Same logic applies to crypto.⁣ ⁣ “The stronger AI gets, it doesn’t make crypto less relevant. The more AI evolves, the more important crypto is.” 🎬⁣ ⁣ #AI #Crypto #Bitcoin #Investing #CryptoNews #ETH #Bankless #TechStocks #Web3 #Markets

entry.title: 140 Million Renters Are Praying for a Housing Crash

media:group.media:title: 140 Million Renters Are Praying for a Housing Crash
media:group.media:description: Jim Bianco breaks down the housing market’s split personality: 180 million homeowners want prices climbing, 140 million renters are stuck praying for a crash.⁣ ⁣ “Affordability is a big problem.”⁣ ⁣ High mortgage rates haven’t stopped home prices from hitting all time highs, they just keep grinding higher.⁣ ⁣ “If we get higher mortgage rates and home prices stall, there’s gonna be a lot of homeowners very mad about it.”⁣ ⁣ But for the renters on the outside looking in, a stall could be the first real shot at getting in the door.⁣ ⁣ #Housing #RealEstate #Renters #MortgageRates #Economy

entry.title: AI Buildout Looks Like the 2000 Dot-Com Bubble

media:group.media:title: AI Buildout Looks Like the 2000 Dot-Com Bubble
media:group.media:description: Jim Bianco says AI is starting to look a lot like the internet in 2000.⁣ ⁣ Back then, Global Crossing laid 100,000 miles of fiber optic cable. Most of it sat dark, unused.⁣ ⁣ “We thought that the demand for the internet was infinite. We overdid it.”⁣ ⁣ Sound familiar?⁣ ⁣ The Nasdaq fell 83% from 2000 to 2002 before the survivors (Google, Amazon, Meta) built the real, sustainable path up.⁣ ⁣ “We’ll overdo this with AI and we’ll have a massive correction.”⁣ ⁣ The tech still wins long term. The road there might not be pretty.🎬

entry.title: Crypto Should Stop Begging Washington for Permission

media:group.media:title: Crypto Should Stop Begging Washington for Permission
media:group.media:description: Jim Bianco says crypto gave up on its own strength to go chase Washington's approval.⁣ ⁣ "You're on bended knee at Washington asking for permission... instead of trying to build an alternative financial system."⁣ ⁣ His point: stop lobbying for the Clarity Act and start building for the billion+ people living under broken currencies.⁣ ⁣ In Venezuela, nobody's converting bolivars to dollars at a bank.⁣ ⁣ "It's probably to a crypto exchange to exchange it to tether."⁣ ⁣ Same story in Afghanistan after 2021 — countries don't dollarize into cash anymore, they dollarize into stablecoins.⁣ ⁣ "That's who desperately needs crypto. Who doesn't need crypto is who they've been chasing for the last couple of years." 🎬
